**Goal:** understand the parts of a sequencing-ready library molecule.

## Exercises

- **Q1** Sketch an Illumina library molecule from 5' to 3'. Label the flow-cell binding sites, the sequencing primer sites, the index and the insert.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal"}
## Hint
There are two flow-cell binding sequences, one at each end (P5 and P7).
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="minimal"}
## Solution
P5 — i5 index — Read 1 primer site — **insert** — Read 2 primer site — i7 index — P7.
:::
